args.title: Fix issue 4192 in src/export/scheduler.ts
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

The export functionality should re-enable the Export button after a failed export attempt. Current handling does not provide this feedback to the user.

label: bug
file: src/export/scheduler.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The export functionality should re-enable the Export button after a failed export attempt. Current handling does not provide this feedback to the user.
